A '''copper spear''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[spear]], crafted from [[copper ingot]]s and sticks. It is the cheapest metal spear and the base for the [[Shakudo Spear|shakudo]] and [[hepatizon spear]]s.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
The copper spear deals {{Hp|2}} damage at an attack speed of 1.18. Unlike the other copper tools it keeps the vanilla copper spear's durability of 190. Otherwise it works like a vanilla {{MCW|spear}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into one copper ingot in a [[blast furnace]], and is upgraded to a shakudo or hepatizon spear at a [[smithing table]].
